scientific_integrity: Original topological map and homeomorphism criterion acknowledged as prior work (Shah--Yadav 2016); all limiting conclusions have an analytical proof. Small numerical checks are corroboration, not certification. Publication priority outside inspected sources is unresolved.
scientific_limitations: Centered cap; pure normalized translation on a round sphere of dimension at least two; each iteration count held fixed as translation strength approaches one; no off-axis, general affine or uniform growing-time statement.
title: Dyadic cap-survival exponents and a square-root critical window for normalized affine sphere maps
